_recipe.title: Local festive offer
_recipe.when: A local shop's Diwali / Holi / Eid / wedding-season sale in Hinglish. Reels, WhatsApp Status.
beats: Hook: the festival + old price struck out + new price lands by ~2s.
Who + what: shop name and the sale name in a highlight box.
What's on offer: four tiles with emoji, item + price.
The big discount as a counting number on a full-colour marigold background.
Extra perks as checks (delivery, gift wrap, free sample).
CTA: WhatsApp / call / visit, with the number and handle.
copyTips: Prices, discount, last date, phone number and address must come from the shop owner. Never guess them.
Swap the festival word in beats 1-2 (Holi, Eid, Navratri, wedding season); for Holi try --theme pop.
Desi + bouncy + fast = festive energy; Hindi in Devanagari renders correctly in this theme.

Say prices as words, show them as ₹999. Beat 1 must reach "ab sirf" inside ~2.5s: at most four words before it, and prices the short way ("Diwali special! Nineteen ninety-nine? Ab sirf nine ninety-nine!").
This cut runs ~30s, right for Stories and WhatsApp Status. Adding copy? Drop the perks beat rather than squeezing words.
